transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get started. We've got the festival streaming special rough cut in front of us, and I need to make a final call on whether the hidden-camera comedy segment stays in the locked master. Before I make that decision, I want to go through our standing reporting round. Standards, insurance, and delivery leads — please each report any constraints on your end. I'll record each constraint as a condition of the settlement and assign the related documentation action. We're not waiting on separate runtime measurements, participant re-checks, or edit-feasibility reviews — we settle this in this round. Who wants to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I reviewed the participant releases and standards notes this morning. The segment may be included only if every participant's face is blurred and every participant's name is removed from the edit. I have not entered the result in the rough-cut notes yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I confirmed with the insurer yesterday that coverage for this segment applies only when all visible participants are adults and each has a signed event waiver. So the final package must identify the participant scope as adults-only and record waiver collection. I have not attached the endorsement to the production file yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I completed the platform ingest check today. This special's delivery profile requires a runtime of exactly 11 minutes or less, 25 frames per second, and stereo audio. I have not updated the delivery worksheet yet.
transcript.speaker: A4
